theorems.name: Submission.allard52_am_fc_cutoff_facts
theorems.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u : ℝ, 1 + ε ≤ u → φ u = 0) → (∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ φ u ∧ φ u ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, deriv φ u ≤ 0) ∧ (∀ u : ℝ, 1 + ε < u → deriv φ u = 0) ∧ Continuous (deriv φ) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ u : ℝ, |deriv φ u| ≤ C
